title: Kirkpatrick lobbied against the UAP Disclosure Act

tellings.quote: And hopefully, when the UAP Disclosure Act goes up for vote again, Sean Kirkpatrick won't lobby against it like he did last time.

plain: Michels says that Sean Kirkpatrick, the first head of the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's current term for UFOs), lobbied against the UAP Disclosure Act, an amendment proposed by Senators Chuck Schumer and Mike Rounds to the yearly defense bill, introduced in the Senate on July 13, 2023, that sought to bring government UFO records to light. Michels says it himself, without naming a source, and hopes Kirkpatrick will not do so again when the act comes back for a vote. If true, the official charged with investigating UAP would have worked against opening the records.
